description: Send one message to a Telegram conversation by its conv_ ref and wait for the reply that answers it. Returns the actual reply from the other side — a message that replies to the sent message, or in a DM the next message after the send — or a timeout when nobody answers. Never resend on a timeout; the message went out.
name: conversations_turn

conversation_ref.description: The conv_ ref from conversations_list for the conversation to message.

message.description: Message to send to that conversation.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the reply (default 60, max 300).
